items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Ross Russell got us together to record with Charlie Parker and Wardell Gray and Dexter Gordon and Howard McGhee

ctx.x: So now it comes out! [LAUGHS] Erroll had ears like you wouldn't believe. So after I had played it, he sat down and started playing it.

So Ross Russell got us together to record with Charlie Parker and Wardell Gray and Dexter Gordon and Howard McGhee and...let's see, maybe some other people, but those are the ones that come to mind. So after we had finished with Charlie Parker one day, Ross said, "Do a couple of things." So we did "Pastels," and after that we played another thing which we had made up called "Trio." items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I had Red Callender and Teddy Edwards... So anyway, we went down to San Diego... He charged me a lot of money.

ctx.x: Had you met Red Callender and Teddy Edwards when you got out to the Coast?

Well, I knew Teddy from Detroit, because I saw him in Detroit. But I didn't know Red Callender, but somebody had told me he was a good bass player, so I called him up, and he said he'd be glad to make it. He put his hand in my pocket, you know, but he made it! So I said, "Okay"... He charged me a lot of money.
Who did you have playing piano?
